welcome.title: Welcome to NEXUS
welcome.text: NEXUS is your frame for AIs: create a project (a folder on your computer) and add the AIs you use. You sign in to each AI yourself; NEXUS stores no credentials and runs entirely on your machine.
project.none: No projects yet. Create one with ＋ above.
project.name: Name
project.folderChangeHint: A different folder applies to new Claude Code chats and terminals; open ones keep running in the old folder.
project.removeText: The project disappears from the list.
project.removeTextDesk.one: The project disappears from the list and its desk with {n} workspace is closed.
project.removeTextDesk.other: The project disappears from the list and its desk with {n} workspaces is closed.
project.removeKeeps: The folder {path} and all files in it stay untouched, as do the Claude Code sessions. You can add the folder again later.
desk.orPick: or click an existing workspace above
ws.clearCell: Clear slot (workspace stays on the desk)
ws.chipHint: Click = show in the active slot
ws.closeText: “{title}” is removed from the desk. The chat itself is kept by the provider or in Claude Code.
web.errorHint: {error} – “⇱” opens the provider in your browser.
web.intercepted: The connection to {host} is being intercepted (certificate from “{issuer}”) – probably a company web filter
ai.title: My AIs
ai.intro: Sign in once: the sign-in applies to all workspaces and desks of this AI and survives restarts.
ai.allAdded: All known AIs have been added.
ai.pickOne: Pick an AI or enter an address.
ai.loginHint: Sign in once – then it applies to all workspaces of this AI
ai.logoutHint: Delete all sign-in data of this AI in NEXUS
ai.logoutText: NEXUS deletes this AI's cookies and storage. Open workspaces of this AI are closed.
ai.removeTextWs.one: The sign-in is deleted and {n} workspace disappears from the desks.
ai.removeTextWs.other: The sign-in is deleted and {n} workspaces disappear from the desks.
ai.removeKeeps: Your chats with the provider are kept.
ai.hint.in: Signed in – applies to all workspaces and desks.
ai.hint.unknown: Set up. NEXUS cannot reliably tell whether you are signed in to this AI.
ai.hint.out: Not signed in. Signing in once covers all workspaces.
settings.title: Settings
settings.langRestart: The new language applies after restarting NEXUS.
settings.themeHint: The sun/moon button at the top right switches between these two themes.
settings.webThemeHint: Web AIs (Claude, ChatGPT …) turn light or dark if their theme is set to “System”. The exact colours are up to the provider.
settings.projectRootHint: NEXUS creates new project folders here and suggests existing folders from here.
settings.notify: Windows notification when Claude needs a decision and NEXUS is in the background
chat.inputHint: / for commands · paste, drop or 📎 images · while a task runs, your message is queued
chat.queue: Queue – Claude reads it as soon as it fits
chat.onlyImages: Images only (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP): skipped {name}
chat.modeFailed: Could not change the mode ({detail}). Reload the workspace (↻) and choose again.
chat.startFailed: Claude Code could not start: {error}. Is Claude Code installed and signed in?
chat.exited: Claude Code exited (code {code}). Reload the workspace (↻) to continue.
chat.denied: Denied by the user in NEXUS.
mode.default.hint: Claude asks before edits and commands
mode.acceptEdits.hint: File edits without asking, commands with asking
mode.auto.hint: Claude decides itself but asks for steps Claude Code considers risky (e.g. git push)
mode.bypassPermissions.hint: Claude does everything without asking – including deleting, pushing, installing. Only use it when you trust the task.
mode.plan.hint: Claude reads and proposes but changes nothing
perm.alwaysEdits: Always allow edits in this chat
perm.autoTip: Auto asks for steps Claude Code considers risky. To never be asked, choose “Never ask” below.
err.nameLength: Please enter a name with 1–60 characters.
err.folderChars: The name contains characters that are not allowed in folder names.
err.folderExists: {root} already contains a folder “{name}”. Choose it as an existing folder instead.
err.folderTaken: This folder is already in NEXUS as the project “{name}”.
notify.title: NEXUS needs your decision
login.title: Sign in to {ai} – NEXUS
login.windowTitle: {ai}: {page} – NEXUS (close this window once you are signed in)
login.blockedMsg: The connection to {host} is being intercepted.
login.blockedDetail:
The certificate does not come from the provider but from “{issuer}” ({error}).

This is usually a company web filter or antivirus blocking the site. NEXUS deliberately does not bypass this check.

Workaround: sign in on a different network (e.g. a private Wi-Fi). The sign-in stays saved in NEXUS afterwards.
migrate.lockedMsg: The old NEXUS (prototype) is still running.
migrate.lockedDetail:
To take over your projects, desks and AI sign-ins cleanly, please close the old NEXUS first and then click “Try again”.

Old data: {dir}
migrate.errorMsg: Your data could not be taken over.
migrate.errorDetail:
{error}

The old data in {dir} is unchanged.
notice.migrated: Your data from the prototype was taken over ({dir} is unchanged). You are still signed in to your web AIs.
notice.recovered: The data file was damaged. NEXUS loaded the latest backup: {file}
mode.pushOnly.hint: Claude does everything without asking – it only asks you before git push.
chat.cleared: Context cleared – new conversation from here
update.title: Updates
update.auto: Download updates automatically (installed when you quit or via “Restart now”)
update.ready: NEXUS {version} is ready. Restart to install it – or it will be installed when you quit.
update.error: Update check failed (e.g. no connection). Please try again later.
update.status.off: Updates are only available in the installed app.
